description: Every %classifier of one name in a stage adds entries to one classifier, applied in stitching order across documents: b.md removes mi from KOhA and adds it to UI, and c.md adds it to KOhA again. Taken in another order, c.md's entry would add a membership that holds (engine §2).

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%classifier lex
  "mi" "do" ∈ KOhA
%rule text [word] ...
%rule word $w(W) <~w ∪ classify(phonemes($w), lex)>
%emits
  $
```
